notes: Added robust per-well/typewell z-scored Pearson Typewell alignment features at windows 21, 51, and 101 over TVT lags [-80, 80]. The median lag across scales was used for smooth consensus and normalized GR residual features. Compared with exp_b001 RMSE 37.1134, exp008 improved by 0.0977; against exp006 target 36.3943, it trailed by 0.6214. Normalization should help when train/test GR scale differs; multi-scale lags help only if local GR motifs have a stable Typewell correspondence.

feature_params.normalization: per well/typewell robust zscore median and MAD*1.4826
feature_params.lag_agreement: std of best lags across windows
feature_params.lag_consensus: centered rolling mean 50 of median best lag
